spec.scene: A small patch of soft green lawn fills the ground, warm afternoon sun pooling across it. At the center, a small elderly cream-colored dog lies curled on a pale blue blanket, a little larger than life. Just behind her, a low lemon tree with glossy leaves and a few round yellow lemons casts gentle dappled shade. Two small seated figures, one in a rust-orange sweater and one in a grey cardigan, sit close together on the grass at the front left, facing the dog. A single tall garden window of a house rises at the back edge, its glass glowing warm gold.
spec.title: Under the Lemon Tree
spec.caption: We sat with Mochi in the sun, under her lemon tree, one last time.
